label: ADR-010: Standardize on 10 Canonical SDLC Skills, Neutralize Engineering Terminology, and Compact README Workflow Diagram

metadata.decision: 1) Consolidate CANONICAL_SDLC_SKILLS to 10 SDLC skills and prune retired skill exports across local and global agent directories; 2) Replace author-specific phrasing across code, skills, specs, wiki, and README with neutral TDD and concentric Clean Architecture terminology; 3) Remove Archlens links from wiki/_Footer.md and README.md footer sections while keeping inline architecture references; 4) Replace the wide horizontal flowchart LR in README.md and wiki/Traceability.md with compact vertical flowchart TD diagrams.

label: ADR-011: Strict sdlc Namespace Isolation and Decoupling from Standalone Coding-Persona Skills

metadata.decision: Restrict both CANONICAL_SDLC_SKILLS (10 skills) and DEPRECATED_SDLC_SKILLS (14 legacy sdlc-* skills) exclusively to the sdlc* namespace. Ensure provisionAgentIntegrations, pruneDeprecatedSkills, auditSkills, and auditWiki ignore all non-sdlc* skills in local and global agent directories so standalone coding-persona and design skills coexist untouched alongside the SDLC suite.

label: ADR-012: Reset Package, Plugin, and Documentation Version Baseline to 0.0.1

metadata.decision: Set package.json, package-lock.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, installer.mjs fallback version, README.md version badge, PRODUCT.md/SRS.md compacted release metadata, and CHANGELOG.md to a clean 0.0.1 baseline, and remove legacy docs/proofs/proof-v0-*.md files.

label: ADR-013: Harden Release Gate, Opt-In Issue Creation, Universal ADR Approval, Diff Review Plans, and Node 24 CI Actions

metadata.decision: Require non-protected branch, gate --strict, and fail-closed git commit/tag in executeRelease; require explicit --issue, --local, --lane trivial, or --create-issue in stage begin; initialize all ADR scopes in pending_approval; embed unified git diff in generateReviewPlan; and upgrade GitHub Actions to Node 24 v7 on local-archlens.
